title: Yap++
tagline: The cutest client modification for Yappin'.
description:
Yap++ adds the things Yappin' doesn't: **deleted messages that turn red instead of vanishing**, a custom background, drafts that survive a refresh, and a cat.

Everything is a plugin, and every plugin can be turned off. Yap++ never saves, sends or otherwise touches your login details.

features.title: Eleven plugins
features.text: Message Logger, Oneko, Draft Saver, ImageSearch and more. All optional.

features.title: Themes and backgrounds
features.text: A background picture, the Yap++ pink theme, and a Custom CSS box.

features.title: Nothing leaves
features.text: No telemetry, no accounts, no API calls except Yappin's own and image hosts.

features.title: Still a cat
features.text: Oneko still follows your mouse around. Obviously.

notes: First release of the rebuild, on the yapin.js-client framework.
Eleven plugins, each with its own settings on the Plugins page.
Plugins, Themes, About and Security pages that look like Yappin's own.
The fake verified badge is drawn by the framework: no token sniffing, no Supabase backfilling.

footer: Made by salami. Yap++ is unofficial.
